data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to announce the launch of Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, nestled in the heart of Dubai Land. This stunning 4-bedroom villa offers the perfect blend of modern design, comfort, and sophistication. With breathtaking views of the pristine polo fields and a 5-star hotel at its core, this is a rare opportunity to live in Dubai’s premier equestrian community.

Property Details:

- Single Row Villa
- 4 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
- 5 Modern Bathrooms
- 3,082 Sq ft Built-Up Area 
- 4,135 Sq ft Starting Plot Size 
- World Class Polo Field View
- Appliances included
- Thoughtfully Designed Layout
- Andaloucian Architecture
- 2 Covered Parking Spaces
- Built-In Solar Power System
- Premium Marble Flooring
- Maid’s bedroom

Finance is available through Provident Real Estate

Community Features:

- 2 Paddle Courts
- 2 Tennis Courts
- 2 Swimming Pools & 2 Fully Equipped Gyms
- Dedicated Pilates Studio
- Golf Shooting Range
- Equestrian Stables
- Polo Academy
- Luxury Spa
- Exclusive Beauty Salon
- Football Training Academy
- Archery Academy
- Multiple Licensed Restaurants & Lounges
- Jewelry Boutique & Premium Bentley Store

A lifestyle reserved for the few. Set within an exclusive resort community, this villa is a true expression of prestige, crafted for those who seek the extraordinary in every detail. From world-class sporting arenas to tranquil wellness sanctuaries, every corner of this community is designed to elevate your everyday life.

Indulge in fine dining, unwind at the luxury spa, or experience the thrill of equestrian excellence all just steps from your doorstep. Here, life flows effortlessly between relaxation and recreation, creating moments that leave a lasting impression.
